title: Stark, which has a deal to supply "kamikaze" drones to the German military, raised €500M from Founders Fund, Sequoia, others; it faced criticism over Thiel ties (Financial Times)
summary: Financial Times: Stark, which has a deal to supply “kamikaze” drones to the German military, raised €500M from Founders Fund, Sequoia, others; it faced criticism over Thiel ties — US billionaire's fund participated in €500mn funding round despite previous criticism of company's links with financier
contentText:
Financial Times :

Stark, which has a deal to supply “kamikaze” drones to the German military, raised €500M from Founders Fund, Sequoia, others; it faced criticism over Thiel ties   —  US billionaire's fund participated in €500mn funding round despite previous criticism of company's links with financier
